name: Touch Designer

feedbacks.name: Operator Parameter
feedbacks.description: Listen for an operator parameter value

notes: Transport is OSC over UDP to a host and port set in the connection config; there is no reply channel and no state is read back from TouchDesigner.

operator_parameter sends the OSC address /op/<Operator Name>/param/<Parameter> with one argument whose OSC type follows the Type dropdown (int, float, string, bool). For bool the module sends T when the value parses to a number greater than 0, otherwise F (source marks this as not ideal, actions.js:26). The receiving side (an OSC In operator or script in the TouchDesigner project) is not part of this module.
expression sends the OSC address /python with one string argument (a Python expression); the receiving TouchDesigner project must evaluate it. Not verified against a running TouchDesigner.

The feedback operator_parameter is boolean and reads only a local cache that the operator_parameter action fills when it is pressed (state.js); it does not reflect the real parameter value in TouchDesigner and is true for any non-empty cached value. Without a prior action press for the same operator and parameter it is false.

The module parses companion variables in the text inputs inside the callbacks (parseVariablesInString) although the option definitions do not set useVariables, so the catalog does not set useVariables.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.11.2: options do not support expressions. The module defines placeholder variables only (variables.js), no real ones.
Complete list of the two actions and one feedback in the source at the inspected commit.
